name: Sygnity S.A.
summary: Sygnity S.A. manufactures and sells IT products and services in Poland and internationally. The company manufactures, purchases, and sells integrated IT systems, infrastructure, and hardware. It also offers computer programming and consultancy; software and IT; data processing; and hardware consultancy services. In addition, the company engages in the implementation, development, and maintenance of proprietary ERP-class IT systems. It serves the banking, financial, public, and public utility sectors. The company was formerly known as Computerland Poland SA and changed its name to Sygnity S.A. in April 2007. Sygnity S.A. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. Sygnity S.A.…
